name: ayurcalm-scheduler

scripts.dev:up: docker compose -p ayurcalm-scheduler build || { echo; echo 'BUILD FAILED: nothing was restarted, so :8080 is still the old code. Fix the error above and run this again.'; exit 1; } && docker compose -p ayurcalm-scheduler up -d
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -p ayurcalm-scheduler build || { echo; echo 'BUILD FAILED: nothing was restarted, so :8080 is still the old code. Fix the error above and run this again.'; exit 1; } && docker compose -p ayurcalm-scheduler down -v && docker compose -p ayurcalm-scheduler up -d
scripts.qa:fresh: npm run dev:reset && npm run qa

description: Self-hosted appointment and therapy scheduler for Ayurveda wellness centres
